current_detail: H3-R2.1.4 is reviewed: all 75 deferred source/pack lines have one owner and all 2266 legal R2 states pass safe admission. Maximum pack current is 3.516 A against the 8-A PF-R2-03 boundary; sustained admission is 1.549 A. Fourteen oversized 5-V/3-A USB-only states are explicitly refused, while 9-V/3-A and 15-V/2-A run every declared profile and charging yields before system load. H3-R2.1.5 now cross-checks and publishes H3-R2.1. Placement/routing, purchasing and fabrication remain unauthorized.
